item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00320","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C11","C03","C13"],"selected_candidate_label":"C11","confidence":0.98,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C11 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template. Both telegrams begin with an FMCS report on an unresolved industry-wide labor dispute, explain the grave national consequences of interrupted essential operations, request continuation of work under existing terms for sixty days from a specified deadline, and ask for acceptance or a prompt reply. C03 and C13 share related status-quo and mediation machinery, but concern extensions of the same steel-dispute process and are less complete matches to the child's initial sixty-day request.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"CYRUS S. CHING, Director of the Federal Mediation and Conciliation Service, has reported to me the status of the disputes","parent_excerpt":"THE DIRECTOR of the Federal Mediation and Conciliation Service has reported to me on the status of the current dispute","explanation":"Distinctively parallel opening that attributes the assessment of an unresolved labor dispute to the FMCS director."},{"child_excerpt":"I am requesting the parties to continue work and operations ... under the wages, terms and conditions now in effect, for a period of 60 days from February 24, 1950.","parent_excerpt":"I am requesting the parties to continue work and operations under the terms of the collective bargaining agreements now in effect for a period of sixty days from July 16, 1949.","explanation":"Nearly identical central operative request, with only the industry, date, and description of existing employment terms adapted."},{"child_excerpt":"During that period, with the active assistance of the Federal Mediation and Conciliation Service, they should earnestly seek to resolve the current disputes through collective bargaining.","parent_excerpt":"I am appointing a Board ... to investigate and to inquire into the issues in dispute and to report to me thereon within forty-five days","explanation":"Both pair the sixty-day status quo with federal machinery intended to facilitate a negotiated settlement, though the child uses FMCS assistance rather than a new fact-finding board."},{"child_excerpt":"I would appreciate your advising me of your acceptance.","parent_excerpt":"I earnestly request all parties to the dispute to accept this proposal and will appreciate a prompt reply.","explanation":"Closely parallel concluding request for acceptance and response."}]}
